Controlled Benchmark Disruption Stress Tests (Scenarios A through E)

Stress-testing analytical detection and simulation engines against real-world pharmaceutical supply chain failure modes.

🚨 Scenario A: API Supplier Delivery Delay

SCN-A

Mechanism: Aurobindo Pharma delays delivery of Amoxicillin Trihydrate by +14 days on purchase order PO-API-001.

Downstream Cascade: Starves tableting cleanroom Line 1 at Baddi plant, threatening a stockout of 20,000 packs of Augmentin T10 at Nagpur DC within 14 days.

Database Grounding: fact_purchase_order.purchase_order_id = 'PO-API-001'

🧪 Scenario B: Batch QA Sterility Retest Hold

SCN-B

Mechanism: Sterility incubator temperature deviation forces a mandatory 14-day retest, delaying Certificate of Analysis (CoA) release on BATCH-AUG-2026-01.

Downstream Cascade: Finished stock sits in plant warehouse under quality_status = 'Quarantine'. The FEFO allocation engine blocks dispatch, preventing stock replenishment.

Database Grounding: fact_batch.batch_id = 'BATCH-AUG-2026-01'

📦 Scenario C: Packaging Shortage

Supplier carton stockout halts packaging lines for both T10 strips and T30 bottles.

MAT-PKG-CART

⏳ Scenario D: MARSL Expiry Exposure

Pallet lot in Chennai DC has 72 days RSL left. Hospital contract requires 90 days. FEFO blocks release.

LOT-AUG-EXP-01

⚙️ Scenario E: Maintenance Conflict

Urgent demand placed on Line 1 during annual overhaul (120 maintenance hours), triggering capacity overload.
